WPFTweaksActivity.name: Activity History - Disable
WPFTweaksActivity.desc: Erases recent docs, clipboard, and run history.

WPFTweaksHiber.name: Hibernation - Disable
WPFTweaksHiber.desc: Hibernation is really meant for laptops as it saves what's in memory before turning the PC off. It really should never be used.

WPFTweaksWidget.name: Widgets - Remove
WPFTweaksWidget.desc: Removes the annoying widgets in the bottom left of the Taskbar.
apply:
# Sometimes if you dont stop the Widgets process the removal may fail

      Get-Process *Widget* | Stop-Process
      Get-AppxPackage Microsoft.WidgetsPlatformRuntime -AllUsers | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers
      Get-AppxPackage MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience -AllUsers | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers

      Invoke-WinUtilExplorerUpdate -action "restart"
      Write-Host "Removed widgets"

WPFTweaksRevertStartMenu.name: Start Menu Previous Layout - Enable
WPFTweaksRevertStartMenu.desc: Bring back the old Start Menu layout from before the gradual rollout of the new one in 25H2. On newer versions of Windows !!THIS TWEAK WILL NOT WORK!!

WPFTweaksDisableStoreSearch.name: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable
WPFTweaksDisableStoreSearch.desc: Will not display recommended Microsoft Store apps when searching for apps in the Start menu.

WPFTweaksServices.name: Services - Set to Manual
WPFTweaksServices.desc: Sets some services to Manual startup and adjusts the SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB registry value to better match system memory, which can significantly reduce the number of svchost.exe processes.

WPFTweaksBraveDebloat.name: Brave Browser - Debloat
WPFTweaksBraveDebloat.desc: Disables various annoyances like Brave Rewards, Leo AI, Crypto Wallet and VPN.

WPFTweaksDisableWarningForUnsignedRdp.name: RDP Unsigned File Warnings - Disable
WPFTweaksDisableWarningForUnsignedRdp.desc: Disables warnings shown when launching unsigned RDP files introduced with the latest Windows 10 and 11 updates.

WPFTweaksEdgeDebloat.name: Microsoft Edge - Debloat
WPFTweaksEdgeDebloat.desc: Disables various telemetry options, popups, and other annoyances in Edge.

WPFTweaksConsumerFeatures.name: ConsumerFeatures - Disable
WPFTweaksConsumerFeatures.desc: Stops promoted app installs and reduces app suggestions from Microsoft Store content.

WPFTweaksTelemetry.name: Telemetry - Disable
apply:
# Disable Defender Auto Sample Submission
      Set-MpPreference -SubmitSamplesConsent 2

      # Disable (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry) Service
      Set-Service -Name diagtrack -StartupType Disabled

      # Disable (Windows Error Reporting Manager) Service
      Set-Service -Name wermgr -StartupType Disabled

      # Disable PowerShell 7 telemetry
      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT', '1', 'Machine')

      Remove-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules" -Name PeriodInNanoSeconds
undo:
# Enable Defender Auto Sample Submission
      Set-MpPreference -SubmitSamplesConsent 1

      # Enable (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry) Service
      Set-Service -Name diagtrack -StartupType Automatic

      # Enable (Windows Error Reporting Manager) Service
      Set-Service -Name wermgr -StartupType Automatic

      # Enable PowerShell 7 telemetry
      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT', '', 'Machine')

WPFTweaksDeliveryOptimization.name: Delivery Optimization - Disable
WPFTweaksDeliveryOptimization.desc: Stops Windows from using your bandwidth to upload updates to other PCs on the internet or local network.

WPFTweaksRemoveEdge.name: Microsoft Edge - Remove
WPFTweaksRemoveEdge.desc: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge by creating dummy MicrosoftEdge.exe file in the legacy Edge folder. This tricks Windows into unlocking the official Edge uninstaller allowing for a system-level removal.
undo:
Write-Host "Installing Microsoft Edge..."
      winget install Microsoft.Edge --source winget

WPFTweaksUTC.name: Date & Time - Set Time to UTC
WPFTweaksUTC.desc: Essential for computers that are dual booting. Fixes the time sync with Linux systems.

WPFTweaksRemoveOneDrive.name: Microsoft OneDrive - Remove
WPFTweaksRemoveOneDrive.desc: Denies permission to remove OneDrive user files, then uses its own uninstaller to remove it and restores the original permission afterward.
apply:
# Deny permission to remove OneDrive folder
      icacls $Env:OneDrive /deny "Administrators:(D,DC)"

      Write-Host "Uninstalling OneDrive..."
      Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $Env:SystemRoot "System32\OneDriveSetup.exe") -ArgumentList '/uninstall' -Wait

      # Some of OneDrive files use explorer, and OneDrive uses FileCoAuth
      Write-Host "Removing leftover OneDrive Files..."

      Stop-Process -Name FileCoAuth,Explorer

      Remove-Item "$Env:LocalAppData\Microsoft\OneDrive" -Recurse -Force
      Remove-Item "$Env:ProgramData\Microsoft OneDrive" -Recurse -Force

      # Grant back permission to access OneDrive folder
      icacls $Env:OneDrive /grant "Administrators:(D,DC)"

      if (-not (Get-ChildItem -Path $Env:OneDrive)) {
          Remove-Item -Path $Env:OneDrive -Recurse
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OneDrive', $null, 'User')
      }

      # Disable OneSyncSvc
      Set-Service -Name OneSyncSvc -StartupType Disabled
undo:
Write-Host "Installing OneDrive"
      winget install Microsoft.Onedrive --source winget

      # Enabled OneSyncSvc
      Set-Service -Name OneSyncSvc -StartupType Automatic

WPFTweaksRemoveHomeAndGallery.name: File Explorer Home and Gallery - Disable
WPFTweaksRemoveHomeAndGallery.desc: Removes the Home and Gallery from Explorer and sets This PC as default.

WPFTweaksDisplay.name: Visual Effects - Set to Best Performance
WPFTweaksDisplay.desc: Sets the system preferences to performance. You can do this manually with sysdm.cpl as well.

WPFTweaksReservedStorage.name: Disable Reserved Storage
WPFTweaksReservedStorage.desc: Disables Windows Reserved Storage (7-10 GB held for updates/temp files). Recommended only on small drives. Re-enable before major Windows feature updates to avoid installation failures.

WPFTweaksRestorePoint.name: Restore Point - Create
WPFTweaksRestorePoint.desc: Creates a restore point at runtime in case a revert is needed from WinUtil modifications.

WPFTweaksEndTaskOnTaskbar.name: End Task With Right Click - Enable
WPFTweaksEndTaskOnTaskbar.desc: Enables option to end task when right clicking a program in the taskbar.

WPFTweaksStorage.name: Storage Sense - Disable
WPFTweaksStorage.desc: Storage Sense deletes temp files automatically.

WPFTweaksWindowsAI.name: Windows AI - Disable And Remove
WPFTweaksWindowsAI.desc: Removes and disables all AI features/packages
apply:
$Appx = (Get-AppxPackage MicrosoftWindows.Client.CoreAI).PackageFullName
      $Sid = (Get-LocalUser $Env:UserName).Sid.Value

      New-Item "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Appx\AppxAllUserStore\EndOfLife\$Sid\$Appx" -Force

      Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers "*Copilot*" | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers
      winget uninstall -e --name "Copilot" --silent --force --accept-source-agreements 2>$null
      Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers

      if ($Appx) {
          Remove-AppxPackage $Appx
      }

      Set-Service -Name WSAIFabricSvc -StartupType Disabled
      Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -FeatureName Recall -Online -NoRestart

      Write-Host "Windows AI Disabled"

WPFTweaksWPBT.name: Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) - Disable
WPFTweaksWPBT.desc: If enabled, WPBT allows your computer vendor to execute programs at boot time, such as anti-theft software, software drivers, as well as force install software without user consent. Poses potential security risk.

WPFTweaksPreventDeviceMetadataFromNetwor.name: Prevent Device Companion Apps
WPFTweaksPreventDeviceMetadataFromNetwor.desc: Prevents additional software from being installed when plugging in devices (e.g. Ads when plugging in a monitor). Poses potential security risk.

WPFTweaksRazerBlock.name: Razer Software Auto-Install - Disable
WPFTweaksRazerBlock.desc: Blocks ALL Razer Software installations. The hardware works fine without any software.

WPFTweaksBlockAdobeNet.name: Adobe URL Block List - Enable
WPFTweaksBlockAdobeNet.desc: Reduces user interruptions by selectively blocking connections to Adobe's activation and telemetry servers. Credit: Ruddernation-Designs
apply:
$hostsUrl = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri https://github.com/Ruddernation-Designs/Adobe-URL-Block-List/raw/refs/heads/master/hosts
      Add-Content -Path "$Env:SystemRoot\System32\drivers\etc\hosts" -Value $hostsUrl

      ipconfig /flushdns
      Write-Host 'Added Adobe url block list from host file'
undo:
Set-Content "$Env:SystemRoot\System32\drivers\etc\hosts" (
          (Get-Content "$Env:SystemRoot\System32\drivers\etc\hosts") -join "`n" -replace '(?s)#New Ver.*', ''
      )

      ipconfig /flushdns
      Write-Host 'Removed Adobe url block list from host file'

WPFTweaksRightClickMenu.name: Right-Click Menu Previous Layout - Enable
WPFTweaksRightClickMenu.desc: Restores the classic context menu when right-clicking in File Explorer, replacing the simplified Windows 11 version.

WPFTweaksDiskCleanup.name: Disk Cleanup - Run
WPFTweaksDiskCleanup.desc: Runs Disk Cleanup on Drive C: and removes old Windows Updates.

WPFTweaksIPv46.name: IPv6 - Set IPv4 as Preferred
WPFTweaksIPv46.desc: Setting the IPv4 preference can have latency and security benefits on private networks where IPv6 is not configured.

WPFTweaksTeredo.name: Teredo - Disable
WPFTweaksTeredo.desc: Teredo network tunneling is an IPv6 feature that can cause additional latency, but may cause problems with some games.
apply: netsh interface teredo set state disabled
undo: netsh interface teredo set state default

WPFTweaksDisableBGapps.name: Background Apps - Disable
WPFTweaksDisableBGapps.desc: Disables all Microsoft Store apps from running in the background, which has to be done individually since Windows 11.

WPFTweaksDisableExplorerAutoDiscovery.name: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
WPFTweaksDisableExplorerAutoDiscovery.desc: Windows Explorer automatically tries to guess the type of the folder based on its contents, slowing down the browsing experience. WARNING! Will disable File Explorer grouping.
apply:
# Previously detected folders
      $bags = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags"

      # Folder types lookup table
      $bagMRU = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU"

      # Flush Explorer view database
      Remove-Item -Path $bags -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bags"

      Remove-Item -Path $bagMRU -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bagMRU"

      # Every folder
      $allFolders = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags\AllFolders\Shell"

      if (!(Test-Path $allFolders)) {
        New-Item -Path $allFolders -Force
        Write-Host "Created $allFolders"
      }

      # Generic view
      New-ItemProperty -Path $allFolders -Name "FolderType" -Value "NotSpecified" -PropertyType String -Force
      Write-Host "Set FolderType to NotSpecified"

      Write-Host Please sign out and back in, or restart your computer to apply the changes!
undo:
# Previously detected folders
      $bags = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags"

      # Folder types lookup table
      $bagMRU = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU"

      # Flush Explorer view database
      Remove-Item -Path $bags -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bags"

      Remove-Item -Path $bagMRU -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bagMRU"

      Write-Host Please sign out and back in, or restart your computer to apply the changes!

WPFToggleDetailedBSoD.name: BSoD Verbose Mode
WPFToggleDetailedBSoD.desc: Gives more information when you blue screen.

WPFToggleBatteryPercentage.name: System Tray Battery Percentage
WPFToggleBatteryPercentage.desc: Shows numeric battery percentage next to the battery icon in the system tray.

WPFToggleDarkMode.name: Dark Theme for Windows
WPFToggleDarkMode.desc: Dark Mode for the system and applications.

WPFToggleNewOutlook.name: Microsoft Outlook New Version
WPFToggleNewOutlook.desc: This will ensures the classic Outlook application is used.

WPFToggleScrollbars.name: Scrollbars Always Visible
WPFToggleScrollbars.desc: If enabled, scrollbars will always be visible. If disabled, Windows will automatically hide scrollbars when not in use.

WPFToggleMouseAcceleration.name: Mouse Acceleration
WPFToggleMouseAcceleration.desc: Makes it so Cursor movement is affected by the speed of your physical mouse movements.

WPFToggleNumLock.name: Num Lock on Startup
WPFToggleNumLock.desc: Toggle the Num Lock key state when your computer starts.

WPFToggleWindowSnapping.name: Window Snapping
WPFToggleWindowSnapping.desc: Toggles the window snapping feature when dragging windows.

WPFToggleStandbyFix.name: S0 Sleep Network Connectivity
WPFToggleStandbyFix.desc: Toggles network connectivity during S0 Sleep which is low power idle in modern laptops.

WPFToggleS3Sleep.name: S3 Sleep
WPFToggleS3Sleep.desc: Toggles between Modern Standby and S3 Sleep, which cuts off power to the CPU while continuing to refresh the memory.

WPFToggleHideSettingsHome.name: Settings Home Page
WPFToggleHideSettingsHome.desc: Toggles the Home Page in the Windows Settings app.

WPFToggleBingSearch.name: Start Menu Bing Search
WPFToggleBingSearch.desc: Toggles Bing web search results in Windows Search.

WPFToggleLoginBlur.name: Logon Screen Acrylic Blur
WPFToggleLoginBlur.desc: Toggles the acrylic blur effect on login screen background.

WPFTweaksDisableLockscreen.name: Lock Screen - Disable
WPFTweaksDisableLockscreen.desc: Skips the lock screen entirely and goes directly to the sign-in screen on boot and wake.

WPFToggleStartMenuRecommendations.name: Start Menu Recommendations
WPFToggleStartMenuRecommendations.desc: Toggles the recommendations section in the Start Menu. WARNING: This will also disable Windows Spotlight on your Lock Screen as a side effect.

WPFToggleStickyKeys.name: Sticky Keys
WPFToggleStickyKeys.desc: Toggles the Sticky Keys, which activate when clicking shift rapidly.

WPFToggleTaskbarAlignment.name: Taskbar Centered Icons
WPFToggleTaskbarAlignment.desc: Toggles the Taskbar alignment either to the left or center.

WPFToggleTaskbarSearch.name: Taskbar Search Icon
WPFToggleTaskbarSearch.desc: Toggles the Search Button on the Taskbar.

WPFToggleTaskView.name: Taskbar Task View Icon
WPFToggleTaskView.desc: Toggles the Task View Button in the Taskbar.

WPFToggleGameMode.name: Game Mode
WPFToggleGameMode.desc: Toggles Windows prioritizes gaming performance by allocating system resources to games.

WPFToggleLongPaths.name: Enable Long Paths
WPFToggleLongPaths.desc: Toggles support for file paths longer than 260 characters in Explorer.
